messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
我目前沒有即時的網球排名資料。根據最近一次公開的 ATP/ WTA 排名（截至 2023 年底），男子單打的世界第一名是 **諾瓦克·德約科維奇**，女子單打的世界第一名則是 **阿什莉·巴蒂**。  

如果你需要最新的排名資訊，建議查閱官方 ATP/WTA 網站或使用專門的體育數據 API，因為排名每週都會更新。

That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. We can answer based on knowledge: For men's singles ATP ranking, as of 2026? Actually current year is 2026. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can approximate: In 2026, likely Novak Djokovic or maybe a new player. But we can't guess. We could say "I don't have real-time data." But we can provide general info: As of 2023, Djokovic was top. But the user asked "currently". We can respond: "I don't have real-time data, but as of last update, Djokovic was top." Or we can ask for clarification. But we can also use the function to get ranking? The function is for team standings, not individual. So we cannot use it. We should respond that we don't have real-time data. Provide best known.
